title: Shallow Alignment Depth Profiling Across Open Reasoning Models

original_idea.body: Replicate Qi et al.'s per-token KL measurement on the reasoning trace of 3-4 small open reasoning models, force harmful prefills at varying depths in CoT vs answer, and plot a safety depth profile.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: mapping where safety lives in reasoning models tells defenders whether prefill attacks generalize.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Replicate per-token KL + prefill attacks; no training.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (safety depth profile) with defined StrongREJECT eval.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Pure open-model evaluation labs underweight, no internal access.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference + activation comparisons on small models.

novelty.reasoning: Shallow alignment established; reasoning-model extension flagged as follow-up.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: An explicit open follow-up, may be partly addressed already.
